name: Maria Lopez
summary: Senior Data Scientist with five years of experience shipping ML models that drive product decisions. Explores data with Python and Pandas, builds models with Scikit-learn, and validates them through rigorous experimentation and A/B testing.
strengths: End-to-end modeling in Python and Pandas from exploration to deployment
Strong statistical grounding for causal analysis and experimentation
Comfortable writing SQL to pull and shape data directly from the warehouse
gaps: Less experience with distributed data engineering and feature pipelines
Deep learning exposure is exploratory rather than production-scale
resumeText: Maria Lopez is a Senior Data Scientist at Cobalt Health with five years of experience across market intelligence and healthcare. She frames problems, explores data with Python and Pandas, builds Scikit-learn models, and validates them through A/B testing and causal analyses. She writes her own SQL and communicates results to leadership, and is now mentoring junior scientists while exploring deep learning approaches.
